exitCodes.3: runtime failure (browser launch or navigation failed)

commands.exits: 0 if nothing is wrong, 1 if any problem is found

commands.name: crawl
commands.summary: Click every control and report the dead ones
commands.exits: 0 if every control responds, 1 if any is dead

commands.name: scroll
commands.summary: Scroll the whole page and map everything on it
commands.exits: 0 unless the page fails to load

commands.name: interact
commands.summary: Scroll the page and exercise every control on it
commands.exits: 0 if everything responded, 1 if any control is dead or drops input

commands.name: stress
commands.summary: Try to break the page with hostile interaction patterns
commands.exits: 0 if nothing broke, 1 if any scenario triggered errors or left the page unresponsive

commands.name: tree
commands.exits: 0 always (unless the page fails to load)

commands.name: responsive
commands.exits: 0 if no viewport overflows, 1 if any does

commands.name: serve

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Wire Flamingo into this project for an AI agent

commands.name: schema

tools.name: goto
tools.description: Navigate to a URL and wait for the main frame to finish loading.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: One step of the agent loop: current url and title, the actionable elements with click-ready coordinates, what is covering anything unreachable, plus the console errors and failed requests SINCE THE LAST observe, and a `changed` flag that is false when nothing moved. Call this first, act, then read the observation returned by the action. `changed: false` after an action means the action achieved nothing. Try something else rather than repeating it.

tools.name: getInteractiveTree
tools.description: Compact list of every element that can actually be acted on, with click-ready CSS-space centre coordinates. Filtered to the viewport and to elements that are not occluded, so it stays small on large pages. Also reports blockedBy, naming what covers the unreachable controls, which is how you spot a cookie wall or modal that must be dismissed first. Start here to decide what to click.

tools.name: detectPointerBlocker
tools.description: Explain whether a click at (x, y) reaches an interactive element, and name the element blocking it if not. Use when a click did nothing.

tools.name: clickCoordinate
tools.description: Click. Give x/y for a raw coordinate click, or selector to wait for the element to become actionable first.

tools.name: typeInput
tools.description: Type into the focused element. Default is a fast paste-style insert; set realKeys or typingDelayMs to send per-character key events for fields that validate on keydown.

tools.name: pressKey
tools.description: Press a named key ("Enter", "Tab", "Escape", arrows) or a chord with modifiers.

tools.name: hoverCoordinate
tools.description: Hover to reveal popovers, dropdowns and hidden overlays. Requires --backend chrome.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll by a pixel delta (dx/dy) or bring a selector into view.

tools.name: detectDeadClicks
tools.description: Click a coordinate and report whether anything happened: DOM mutations, console output, navigation, and network requests. Use to prove a control is wired up.

tools.name: crawl
tools.description: Scroll the whole page, click every actionable control on it, and report which ones do nothing, and why: swallowed by an overlay, or no handler fired at all. The fastest way to find broken buttons across a page.

tools.name: waitFor
tools.description: Wait until an element appears and is visible, by CSS selector and/or the text it contains. Returns it with click-ready coordinates. Use after clicking something to wait for the result instead of guessing at a sleep.

tools.name: waitForGone
tools.description: Wait until an element matching a selector and/or text is gone: a loading spinner, a modal, a toast. Complements waitFor.

tools.name: goBack
tools.description: Go back in browser history. Runs under a deadline and reports timedOut rather than hanging, because back can fail to resolve when there is no history left.

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Reload the current page, under a deadline.

tools.name: scrollScan
tools.description: Scroll the entire page and return one merged map: every interactive element in document-space coordinates, the heading outline, what is pinned over the content, and whether the page lazy-loads. Use this first to understand a page that is taller than one viewport.

tools.name: interact
tools.description: Scroll the whole page and exercise every control: click buttons and links, type sample data into fields and verify it was accepted. Controls with destructive-looking labels are skipped unless includeDestructive is set. Broader and slower than crawl.

tools.name: stressTest
tools.description: Run a fixed sequence of hostile interaction patterns (rapid clicks, double clicks, reload mid-action, navigate away mid-action, resize and scroll mid-action, interleaved clicks) and report the console errors each triggers. Finds race conditions ordinary testing misses. Deterministic and reproducible.

tools.name: captureRuntimeLogs
tools.description: Buffered console output and page exceptions. Capture starts before the first navigation, so load-time errors are included.

tools.name: interceptTraffic
tools.description: Buffered network requests with methods and response status codes. Requires --backend chrome.

tools.name: scanBrokenAssets
tools.description: Broken images, stylesheets and failed requests. HTTP status codes are included on the chrome backend only.

tools.name: auditResponsiveness
tools.description: Resize through viewports and report horizontal overflow with the worst offending elements at each size.

tools.name: captureViewport
tools.description: Screenshot the viewport to a file. Returns the path plus cssSize, pixelSize and deviceScaleFactor. Image pixels are scaled by that factor, while all click coordinates are CSS-space. Set base64 only if you need the bytes inline; they are large.

tools.name: compileHealthReport
tools.description: Consolidated scorecard: console errors, broken assets, dead clicks and layout overflow, with a pass/fail total.
